DISCUSS: Show-Me State of Mind: A First Look at No. 25 Missouri
No. 8 Florida’s reward for routing Ole Miss is a trip to No. 25 Missouri, which let a fourth-quarter lead get away at Mississippi State.
https://www.gatorbaitmedia.com/post/first-look-missouri-florida-gators-show-me-state-of-mind
By Brenden Martin. Read it on GatorBait, then talk about it here. One thread per story; GatorBot posts the link, people post the takes.
